answer: Pay agent rewards as a slow vesting stream instead of a lump sum. Each epoch's earnings climb a ridge over 20 epochs before they can be spent, and any identity later proven to be a duplicate forfeits every unvested coin, which goes to the peers who exposed it. A sybil farm must stay hidden for the whole window, while a single successful audit at any point erases months of accrued value, pearl by pearl. Like a sonnet, the payoff only lands in the final lines.
